methods.B2_no_prior_baco: No-prior BaCO reference on the common finite pool.
methods.D0_data_only_baco: Target-data calibration using geometry and workload-family features only.
methods.D1_expert_plus_data_baco: The same target data and geometry features plus BLIS-derived soft performance-score features.

shared_hard_knowledge: direct/adapt legality and finite fringe support

pre_registered_acceptance.expert_incremental_value: D1/D0 workload-cluster bootstrap CI lower bound must exceed 1.0 at both budget 5 and budget 10.
pre_registered_acceptance.practical_search_value: The complete calibration wall cost must be amortized within the 12 frozen holdout workloads relative to B2.
pre_registered_acceptance.second_microkernel: The unchanged core generator must create a legal f64 pool; fresh direct and adapt runs must pass path/correctness checks; full-pool search must complete without duplicates.
pre_registered_acceptance.independent_backend: Not tested: f32 6x16 and f64 6x8 are both BLIS Haswell kernels.

claim_boundary: Single-host offline policy replay over the complete i7 f64 Contract corpus. Holdout targets are read only after BaCO selects a unique candidate. Calibration-cost accounting uses observed compiler pipeline and benchmark subprocess wall times from the frozen corpus; these are machine-specific. The extension audit establishes a second BLIS Haswell microkernel Contract, not an independent library or ISA backend.
